notes: Summary: Large national payment+health claims processor. Heavy PCI+PHI requirements — will not accept public-cloud multi-tenant endpoints for any transcript or recording data. Wants a VPC private deployment with optional on-prem connector for call recordings. Primary use: agent-assist (real-time suggestions), automated ticket summarization, and tool-calling into Genesys + ServiceNow workflows. Key non-negotiables: Okta SSO/SAML, BYOK with HSM (customer-owned keys), immutable audit logs with 7+ year retention, and ability to prove data residency for PHI. Reliability: must sustain 500 concurrent agent sessions and absorb spikes to 1,500 sessions during peak (Black Friday equivalent); request automatic fallback to smaller model variants without dropping sessions. Cost sensitivity: reasonable committed spend for Dedicated capacity but expects Optimize recommendations to reduce unit cost (intelligent batching + caching).

Week2: integration with Genesys + ServiceNow via tool-calling; validate function-calling flows and structured outputs
